hooks.command: npx --no-install reins hook guard-bash || { [ $? -eq 2 ] || echo 'the harness guard did not run (is @dom-kelly/reins installed? ask the user to run npm install)' >&2; exit 2; }
npx --no-install reins hook typecheck || { [ $? -eq 2 ] || echo 'the harness typecheck hook did not run (is @dom-kelly/reins installed? ask the user to run npm install)' >&2; exit 2; }

npx --no-install reins hook validate-on-stop || { [ $? -eq 2 ] && exit 2; echo 'the harness validate-on-stop hook did not run (is @dom-kelly/reins installed? ask the user to run npm install)' >&2; exit 1; }
